summary.text: Nathan Ballentine is a Republican state representative who has represented South Carolina House District 71, in Lexington and Richland counties, since 2005 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballentine is a market leader at Movement Mortgage and serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Ballentine earned a B.S. from the University of South Carolina in 1992 and sits on the Dean's Advisory Council of the university's Darla Moore School of Business.

His legislative biography lists his work as a market leader for Movement Mortgage and his membership in several Midlands business and civic groups, including the Greater Columbia Association of Realtors and the Irmo and Greater Chapin chambers of commerce.
Ballentine has served in the House since 2005 and was named Legislator of the Year in 2013, according to his official biography.
He chairs the S.C. Energy Caucus and was Majority Party Whip in 2017.
The Republican primary on June 9, 2026, was canceled, and Ballentine faces Democrat Julie Zimmerman in the November 3 general election.
